title: Emenegger gave a copy of the documentary to Spielberg

tellings.quote: "No, he didn't tell me what I didn't tell you. I gave a copy to Spielberg."

plain: A filmmaker named Bob Emenegger, who made a documentary called UFOs Past Present and Future, is said to have given a copy of it to the film director Steven Spielberg in the mid-1970s, before Spielberg made Close Encounters of the Third Kind, his film about alien contact. A man named Grant Cameron repeats what Emenegger told him: "I gave a copy to Spielberg." Cameron tells it as a hint that Spielberg's film may have drawn on material the documentary carried.
